verdict.rationale: Render's own homepage advertises migration credits for moving production infrastructure, which directly matches the story. The evidence is a single marketing line, so the depth and terms of the offer are unproven. missing for 10: eligibility criteria and application process, documented terms (what the credits cover, expiry, how 'up to $10K' is determined), and independent or hands-on confirmation that teams actually received credits.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can receive migration credits when moving my production infrastructure to a new platform

citations.quote: Migrating production infrastructure? Get up to $10K in migration credits.
